python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img29 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0029.png')
# Plant 1 pot is on the right:
mask_pot = (img29[:,:,2] > 100) & (img29[:,:,1] > 40) & (img29[:,:,1] < 90) & (img29[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 400)
# Chair 1 is in center (x in [200, 350])
mask_chair = (img29[:,:,2] > 80) & (img29[:,:,2] < 150) & (img29[:,:,1] > 35) & (img29[:,:,1] < 80) & (img29[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 350)
ys_c, xs_c = np.where(mask_chair)
print('Actual Chair 1 in obs 29: x in [', xs_c.min(), xs_c.max(), '], y in [', ys_c.min(), ys_c.max(), '], bottom y =', ys_c.max())
d_c1 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_c.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Actual Chair 1 dist = {d_c1:.2f} m')
theta = np.deg2rad(315)
alpha = np.arctan((xs_c.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0)
tot_ang = theta + alpha
x_c1 = -0.5 + d_c1 * np.sin(tot_ang)
y_c1 = 3.3 + d_c1 * np.cos(tot_ang)
print(f'Actual Chair 1 coords: x = {x_c1:.2f}, y = {y_c1:.2f}')
"
